description.narrative: Prize Holding Chile SpA. and its subsidiaries is a group of companies engaged in producing, processing, packing and selling fruits, specifically, cherries, blueberries, pears, walnuts, plums, nectarines, grapes, kiwis, oranges, tangerines and apples, among others. Organized in Chile, the Company is expanding its operations to Peru and Mexico.The financing proposed consists in a senior loan of up to US$20 million over 390 days, a long-term senior loan for up to US$70 million over a maximum term of 10 years earmarked for the Company’s investment program for 2024 and 2025 in order to increase production, implement new technologies and efficiencies in its operations in Chile, Peru and Mexico. In addition there will be a line to finance working capital in the amount of up to US$30 million.
